title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode8 The Sound I Want Them To Hear

meta.Episode: Episode8 — The Sound I Want Them To Hear
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: The next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<*Nod*
This really is a wonderful song...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <All that's left is to hear what the others have to say after they listen to it today.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you nervous, Ichika?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Of course I am.
This is the first actual song I've written.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Saki always writes these amazing songs for us, so I'm worried that it's going to pale in comparison...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't think you have anything to worry about. Music isn't about comparing yourself to others.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Listening to your song, Ichika, I got a clear sense of what sort of message you were trying to send. So, I think it's fine the way it is...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I'm so glad I asked you to join me today, Miku. It's like the first time I showed everyone my lyrics. I'm so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Whoa! It's already this late?!
Sorry for making you help me with that stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sounds like they're here.
Good luck, Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi! Sorry for being so late!
The teacher asked me to do some stuff and...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Hello, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm?
Miku's here too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We were having a little chat.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were? About what?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-So... There's something I need to ask all of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?! What's going on?!
Oh, is this about the new pancake place that just opened up near school?! I've been thinking we should check it out, too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I seriously doubt it, Saki, so please be quiet for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Haha... The thing is... Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wrote my own song, and I want you all to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your own song...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You wrote one, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
Ichi, you wrote a song?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's so awesome!
I had no idea that you were working on one! I really wanna hear it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see. It's finally done...
I'm so happy for you, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Hona, you knew...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yes...
I happened to walk in on Ichika working on it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
Why didn't you tell us?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Please don't blame her.
I wanted to have you all listen to it when it was complete, so I asked her to keep it a secret until then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a sec... That giggle...
Miku, you knew too, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I did. However, I only heard about it yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair! No fair!
Lemme listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to hear your song as well, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Of course. That's why I brought it up. I am a little nervous... But I want to hear your honest opinions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh wow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This song's super duper amazingly good! How do I put it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's so you, Ichi!
There's so much warmth... And so much kindness in the lyrics. It's like you're saying you'll be there when I really need you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like I'm being wrapped in a warm blanket... And I really like how it captures you so well, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, you two...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I didn't realize that's how you saw her, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, I was just trying to give my impression, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Miku's voice is also really beautiful.
It goes so well with the song... Actually, Ichika, this Miku kind of reminds me of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, Miku...reminds you of me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it's like...
Your feelings and her feelings have become one, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just through Miku's voice, you make it clear that you care about her very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, but you sorta just made this for fun, right, Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was thinking I kinda wanna play it as Leo/need.
How would you feel about that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'd like to play it as well.
I was really wondering how it'd sound if we did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You had that in mind when you wrote it, didn't you Ichika? I mean, it uses the same instruments we do, and your message... It all feels like Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Shiho. That's right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That means...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If you're all okay with it...
I'd like for us to play this song as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course we're okay with it!
I mean, Ichi, it's your debut as a songwriter♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I have a suggestion regarding that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For this song, why don't we have a video of us playing it and a separate one using this Miku version?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The way she sings it is so beautiful that I feel like it'd be a waste to not include her somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, two videos...?
One of us performing and another of Miku singing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I think that'd be great!
I personally really love Miku videos. I watch them all the time!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plenty of other people like Miku, so we may be able to reach more people by making a video with her in it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's voice is going to help my song reach all those people...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also want lots and lots of people in your world to hear the song you and her created, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song, your thoughts, your feelings, this melody... The people who need it most are going to be so touched by them all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want it to reach as many people as possible too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our song... With Miku!
A few days later
Scramble Crossing

*Sigh*
I come all the way out to a live house when I'm supposed to have the day off, and... Another swing and a miss.
To be fair, it's not exactly easy to find a diamond in the rough. In terms of that...
That show was something else.
But there's no information out there about that band. I figured that high school kids would be posting videos and stuff online, but...
When I checked after the show, they didn't even seem to have any channels set up... Hm?
Wait, this is...!
Four subscribers... So, the four of them? Did they just set up this channel?
Hey, they even posted a Miku song...

Leo/need...
Seems I'll need to keep an eye on them.
